title: Studio's new-package form offers manifest.scope cloud and system, which POST /api/v1/packages now refuses (objectstack#24062)
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible defect in Studio with a named landing. **`reach:`** named real producer: Studio's new-package form, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog.tsx` create mode, which POSTs `/api/v1/packages { manifest }`.

**Reader who acts:** the objectui `domain:ui` seat, once an installable `@objectstack/spec` release carries `PackageInstallManifestSchema` (objectstack PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24160, `eda6f14b7b`, landed 2026-10-17; unreleased at filing).

**Filed by** the objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#18549) · `huangyiirene` · session `session_01HSDGREvqxQUt7K7pjHXMyC`, from the contract review of objectstack-ai/objectstack#24160 (record `6231622048`, ③ item 3). ⛔ Not a claim; grade and route are triage's.

## Measured (objectui at the console pin `5e15928b4631`, by source read)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/package-schema.ts` builds the package form from `z.toJSONSchema(ManifestSchema)` (`getPackageSchema`, about `:55`), and `PACKAGE_FORM_FIELDS` includes `scope` (about `:41`–`:51`). The `scope` row is `immutable: true` (about `:157`–`:161`), which locks only after create, so on create a user can pick any value `ManifestSchema.scope` offers: `cloud`, `system` or `project`.
- `PackageFormDialog.tsx` create mode starts the draft with no `scope` on purpose (about `:336`–`:341`) and spreads the draft into the POST body (about `:473`–`:483`), so a `scope` the user picked is sent.
- Since objectstack-ai/objectstack#24160, `POST /api/v1/packages` refuses `scope: 'cloud'` and `'system'` with `400` / `VALIDATION_ERROR` and a remedy sentence (drop `scope`, or write `'project'`). Before it, the same choice answered `201` and created a package that no API door could delete, disable or overwrite (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24062).

So the form now offers two values the server always refuses. Picking one is loud (the dialog shows the `400`), not destructive, but the option should not be offered.

## Scope

- Derive the create form's `scope` options from the install declaration, `PackageInstallManifestSchema` (exported from `@objectstack/spec/api`), instead of `ManifestSchema`, or leave `scope` off the create form (the server defaults it to `project`). Edit and view modes keep reading `ManifestSchema` for existing rows, whose scope can legitimately be `cloud` or `system`.
- ⛔ No client-side rule of its own: the options come from the spec declaration.
- Unrelated stale comment in the same file, worth fixing in the same PR: `PackageFormDialog.tsx` about `:337` says `scope: 'project'` "marks a read-only CODE package"; `PackagesPage.tsx` (about `:196`) now reads the server's served `writable` verdict, never a guess from `scope`.

## Done when

- Studio's new-package form offers no `scope` value the install door refuses, and a test pins the option set against `PackageInstallManifestSchema`.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included: `Studio package form scope cloud system options new package create manifest scope` → 2 hits (#2505 package OWD overview, #2258 package-create UX dogfood follow-ups), neither covers this; `PackageFormDialog scope field read-only package self-lock install refused` → 0 hits.

Dedupe words: package form scope options cloud system; PackageInstallManifestSchema Studio create; new package scope refused 400.
